purpose: Human-readable source of truth for approved story character visuals. Future visual passes should preserve locked designs unless explicitly re-approved.

canonNotes: Working visual canon only; not permanently final-locked.

Identity follows the current approved Luca board: light skin, green eyes, natural freckles, shoulder/above-shoulder wavy bleached-blonde hair with visible dark regrowth, facial piercings and adult 30-year-old appearance.
Runtime V1 look uses round glasses, pink cardigan, simple black camisole/tank styling and restrained believable jewelry.
Hair, outfit, glasses, jewelry and accessories remain scene-variable; this runtime outfit is not a permanent story-time outfit lock.
Legacy Luca runtime illustrations must not be used as identity references for new generation.
Runtime portrait PNGs were rebuilt with true transparency on 2026-09-06 so hair strands no longer carry a white matte/halo in Story Mode.
expressionNotes: V1 core runtime set approved as good-enough-for-now on 2026-08-26: Neutral, Warm/Amused, Skeptical/Side-Eye, Mild Annoyed and Flustered/Caught Off Guard.
Use subtle intensity appropriate to Luca’s current trust/self-control; do not over-broadcast hidden feelings.
Further expressions may be added later without invalidating this working set.
luca.legacyRule: Older white-matte Luca runtime portraits and legacy character illustrations are transitional only and are excluded as visual-generation references.

canonNotes: Young adult Pro Hero; attractive, sharp anime face rather than an older/rugged look.
Red eyes; face should stay relatively compact rather than long or overly angular.
Large, irregular combat/explosion-type scars on face, neck, shoulders, arms and hands; avoid making every scar look like a thin knife cut.
Off-duty base: black tank top, relaxed black streetwear, black jacket with warm orange-red lining.
User-approved 2026-10-21 replacement: seven expression-distinct transparent off-duty sprites at a uniform 1122x1402 crop.
Hair uses grouped readable spikes; face and build are consistent across all seven variants. All scene references use the explicit emotional routing in bakugo-visual-map.js.
User-approved 2026-10-21 Pro Hero outfit: seven aligned transparent sprites, same expression categories and zoom as the off-duty set.
Story narrator/scene expressions remain unchanged; the existing resolver converts the original hero-costume mood keys into neutral, annoyed, angry, proud, flustered, surprised and worried.
Hero and off-duty sprites remain two distinct costumes; never display the black tank top in a hero-costume scene.
The superseded 24 hero PNGs were removed after redirecting runtime references and checking story expression coverage.
bakugo.legacyRule: Pre-2026-10-21 off-duty and Pro Hero sprite PNGs are superseded and removed. Their original scene-emotion aliases continue to work through the runtime mapper.

compatibilityAliases.hero: Hero outfit: 7 canonical emotion variants routed by bakugo-visual-map.js

expressionNotes: Seven canonical off-duty emotions: neutral, annoyed, angry, proud, flustered, surprised, worried. Existing names map semantically without breaking authored Story IDs.
These are reusable transparent character cutouts and must not include apartment backgrounds.
Both outfits share the same seven semantic emotion IDs; story legacy aliases resolve through bakugo-visual-map.js.
Different outfit selection never changes the story scene IDs, relationship, unlocks or chapter progress.

canonNotes: Adult Pro Hero; attractive, muscular and athletic, but with a youthful, warm and emotionally readable face rather than an overly rugged older-man look.
Long vivid red spiky hair with a strong silhouette and larger readable spike groups; preserve the approved 2026-08-25 base design across future expressions.
Red eyes and clearly recognizable shark-like pointed teeth.
Multiple ear piercings and a simple dog-tag style necklace are part of the approved off-duty visual identity.
Off-duty base is intentionally distinct from Bakugo: light gray athletic tank top, red sleeveless hooded layer/vest with black trim, black cargo-style pants and red/black accessories.
Build should read powerful and broad-shouldered without becoming disproportionately bulky.

Rendering lock: polished anime/otome character art with clean detailed linework, warm painterly cel-shading and the same overall quality/framing discipline as the approved Bakugo V2 set, while preserving Kirishima’s own visual identity.
planned: Additional more differentiated off-duty emotions may be added later without invalidating this approved starter pack.
Hero Costume Kirishima visual pass remains optional future work.
kirishima.legacyRule: Older Kirishima baseline/headshot experiments are not canonical visual references for new story content once this V1 off-duty base is available.
expressionNotes: Off-duty starter pack approved 2026-08-25: Neutral, Happy/Friendly, Annoyed/Serious, Flustered/Soft, Angry/Intense, Tired/Vulnerable and Teasing/Confident.
This is a story-ready baseline pack, not a claim that Kirishima’s emotional range is complete; later packs may add subtler or more differentiated variants.
Warmth is a core contrast with Bakugo: Kirishima may smile broadly, show his shark teeth and read as approachable without becoming a generic cheerful-only character.
Serious, angry, tired and vulnerable states must remain visibly distinct so he retains emotional range and independent dramatic weight.
Future sprites should keep clothing, hair silhouette, face proportions, muscular build, piercings, necklace and rendering consistent unless the user explicitly approves a redesign.
